subject: How are meandB and sddB derived for the functions in r?

messages.author: 03851d001d97ecc0
messages.subject: How are meandB and sddB derived for the functions in r?
parts:
I'm getting a different value when I use the meandB function in r than when I use the formula =10*LOG10(AVERAGE(10^(B**:B**/10))) to calculate the mean in Excel.

Thanks!

messages.author: 65c82d09eac308cf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] How are meandB and sddB derived for the functions in r?
parts:
Hello,
Just type in the R console the name of the function. This will return the code and so the math used.
HTH
Best
Jerome

> meandB
function (x, level = "IL") 
{
    if (level == "IL") {
        a <- 10
    }
    else {
        a <- 20
    }
    return(a * log10(mean(10^(x/a))))
}

> sddB
function (x, level = "IL") 
{
    if (level == "IL") {
        a <- 10
    }
    else {
        a <- 20
    }
    x <- 10^(x/a)
    res <- a * (sd(x)/(mean(x) * log(10)))
    return(res)
}
